thread:
Maya: Quick thread — proposals for 'query snaps' ownership and API contract. Trying to finalize before the rollout.
Alex: +1 need clear defaults. Root question: who owns a snapshot created from a per-route view? route-owner, creator, or team?
Kevin: My vote: creator + optional route-bound ownership. If route pinned by team, snapshot should default to 'route' scope.
Maya: Agreed. UX: show a small badge 'scope: route/team/org/private'. Default to 'private' unless the view was opened from a route that has team ownership.
Samir: Also need an API field for telemetry bundling. We have to tag samples with `saved_query_id` and `scope` so cost/telemetry maps correctly.
Alex: Example payload:
```json
{
  "name": "NR route latency filters",
  "route_id": "route:nyc-nr-123",
  "model_ids": ["redwood-13b", "rw-8k-beta"],
  "scope": "route",
  "creator": "maya",
  "pinned": true,
  "sample_rate": 0.05
}
```
Maya: That looks good. We should include `quota_hint` (est tokens / samples per day) so front-end can show cost preview.
Kevin: For rollouts, add `visibility_overrides`: list of teams allowed to modify. If omitted, only creator + route admins.
Samir: Telemetry alignment: backend will attach `saved_query_id` to sampled traces and to per-route aggregations. Need to update queryflow ETL schema.
Alex: One more UX ask: when a team-route default exists, creating a private snap should offer an easy 'make route-default' toggle with permission check.
Maya: Implementation plan: UI + API changes (4 tasks), backend telemetry + quotas (3 tasks), SRE rollout gating (canary config) (1 task). I'll PR a design doc.
Samir: Also flagging rate-limit behaviour: saved queries used in dashboards may burst. Suggest adding `expected_throughput` hint.
Kevin: OK can we lock the API contract today? if so I'll start the backend model-binding work.
Maya: Locking after quick design review. @alex @kevin please +1 or comment on the doc I just posted in GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/142
Alex: +1
Kevin: +1
console-bot: deploy scheduled: saved-query-api v2 -> staging at 2025-04-12T22:00:00Z :rocket:
Maya: thanks all, will aggregate notes and drop a follow-up in #product/meeting-notes.
